mode: standalone fallback (proposed destinations not being added); ids are the if_declined / standalone ids
shared_notes: resolve-pin.py was run for all 34 places; its Overpass endpoint (overpass-api.de) returned nothing in this session, so it fell back to Photon. A copy pointed at overpass.private.coffee was run as well (results in the pins below); extra OSM names were looked up with Nominatim and Photon. Pins marked HIGH have two sources within 100 m; MEDIUM one precise feature of the right type; LOW-by-tool pins are town or park visitor points from a single listing and are flagged for review.

NPWS park entry fee (per NPWS pages loaded today): Mungo, Kinchega and Sturt are $8 per vehicle per day; Mutawintji, Gundabooka, Paroo-Darling and Toorale pages state no entry fee, so they are marked free (camping and tours extra); confirm.

Time zones: Wikivoyage Broken Hill says only Broken Hill and Silverton are on ACST (Australia/Broken_Hill); all other towns are AEST (Australia/Sydney). The NPWS Mutawintji tour page confirms Mutawintji keeps Eastern time. Tibooburra, Menindee and Cameron Corner stay in Australia/Sydney (NSW law); locals sometimes keep Central time (not verified).

Road/closure caveats: NPWS parks say they are always open but may close for weather or fire danger; the NPWS Walls of China page warns roads may close in wet weather and mobile coverage is limited; Gundabooka and Paroo-Darling roads are dirt (Wikivoyage). Live NPWS alerts load by script and were not readable; the Kinchega Woolshed page showed "Affected by closures" with 2 Closed-parks alerts whose text was not read.
Wikivoyage Outback New South Wales gives White Cliffs at -30.777922,143.079204, about 8.8 km north of the village; the placement used it. Corrected here.

Placement counted 34 kept places: 23 spots plus 11 proposed destinations (Broken Hill, Lightning Ridge, Cobar, Brewarrina, five parks with kept spots and three thin parks: Sturt, Gundabooka, Paroo-Darling, Toorale were all skeptic-kept). All are researched as standalone fallbacks. Tibooburra, Menindee, Balranald, Wilcannia and the rejected items are not researched (review/reject).
